title: Add error handling to the database connection pool
notes: These are OpenClaw's own answers, not casr's: the 8 messages and their roles are what SessionManager.buildSessionContext() + convertToLlm() produce for this file, obtained by running both out of openclaw@2026.7.1-2. The file holds 14 entries, 12 on the live branch; the 2 off it are an abandoned rewrite the user rewound away and must not appear. The four consecutive User turns are, in order, a bashExecution record (which has no `content` field and is rendered by bashExecutionToText), a custom_message entry, a branch_summary, and a real user turn — each of which the pre-fix reader dropped, and the abandoned pair of which it resurrected. `has_tool_results` was `false` while the reader deliberately dropped `toolCallId` and `isError` to work around a claude_code writer that emitted tool_result blocks instead of the message's text; that writer now emits both, so the fields are read. OpenClaw's own answer was always `true`: createToolResultMessage (`dist/proxy-BzhBz8iM.js:727-737`) builds `{role:'toolResult', toolCallId, toolName, content, isError}` and convertToLlm hands all of it to the provider.
